text: ハナダ　シティに　いくには　どうくつを　ぬけないと　だめだよ！

structure.jp: ハナダ　シティに　いくには
structure.en: in order to go to Cerulean City

structure.jp: どうくつを　ぬけないと
structure.en: if you don't go through the cave

patterns.name: 〜ないとだめだ
patterns.span: ぬけないと　だめだ
patterns.explanation: Literally 'if you don't, it's no good', this is a casual way to say you must. ぬけないと　だめだ = 'you have to go through'.

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: には after a plain verb says what goal the rest of the sentence is about. ハナダ　シティに　いくには = 'in order to get to Cerulean City'.

patterns.name: 〜を (moving through)
patterns.span: どうくつを　ぬけない
patterns.explanation: With verbs of moving, を shows the place you pass through. どうくつを　ぬけない = 'not go through the cave'.
